title: Scripted-policy campaign manifest
description: One policies.yaml per policies/<campaign>/ directory. A campaign is a set of hand-written policies sharing code files and provenance; each entry under `policies` is one policy with one measured score. The style rules are tasks/shared_spec.schema.json's: additionalProperties false everywhere, and absence is explicit -- a null score.value REQUIRES a reason, never a zero-fill.

campaign.description: Must equal the directory name under policies/.

family.description: Which runtime family the code imports against. metaworld and humanoidbench are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE at runtime (mujoco==3.3.0 vs 3.1.6); no interpreter runs both. bird_control is this repo's own pure-numpy tier (bird/envs/control.py, bird/envs/toy.py): no external runtime, runs in every venv.

pattern.description: closure: make_policy(p) -> act(obs) in normalised action units. rig: make_x(**consts) -> fn(rig, t, ctrl) in RAW actuator units over a mujoco Rig/Shim.

code.description: Files in this directory: the policy code and its constants, kept as they were measured. Never edited to fit a convention -- the wrappers in bird/policy_api.py adapt.

archive.description: Where the policy's development record is, if distributed.

date.description: The day the result was recorded -- the LAST day of work, not the first.

log.description: Repo-relative path of the write-up, or null.

assets.description: Non-policy artifacts worth keeping next to the code, such as write-ups.

pattern.description: Per-policy override of the campaign-level pattern.

task.description: tasks/<id> directory this policy solves. null (with task_reason) when it has no task spec.

env_id.description: registry.names("env") entry, i.e. a valid problem.env_id: the BIRD adapter the score was measured through.

gym_id.description: The underlying library's own env id, when one exists.

kwargs_from.description: JSON file in this dir whose object is splatted into the factory call.

entry.description: Factory in a `code` file: what bird.policy_api loads, and what scripts/eval_policy.py reproduces the score through.

rig.description: For pattern rig: the Rig/Shim class the controller reads. Must be constructed over the BIRD adapter's own _env (see README).

params.description: The tuned constants, inline. Prefer this or params_file -- a policy without its constants is not reproducible.

value.description: The headline number ON THE STANDARD ENV under the standard reset. Any other number goes in `secondary`, named.

unit.description: The task spec's own metric as the BIRD adapter scores it. The benchmark's own episode return, where one exists, is a different quantity and lives in per_seed_hb_return / secondary.

threshold.description: The success bar in this unit, when one exists.

per_seed_hb_return.description: The benchmark's own episode return per seed, in per_seed's order, copied from the record's rows[].reference_return -- for a HumanoidBench entry, the per-seed series in the benchmark's own metric (its episode return). A per-seed distribution in the task's own metric is drawn from this wherever that metric is the HB return, and never from per_seed there: a distribution of this repo's per-step fraction is not a distribution of the benchmark's score. It must equal the cited record.

secondary.description: Named extra numbers: min, any_step, hb_return_mean, ...

verified_through.description: bird_adapter: the repo's own EnvAdapter scored it -- the instrument of record.

verified_at_commit.description: The repo commit whose adapter scored it. null means it was not recorded -- say so in notes, never guess one.

record.description: Per-seed evaluation record (JSON) in this directory. The value must be re-derivable from it.
